content: PolicyKit1 supervision gap closed: polkit-dinit provides polkit-elogind-dinit (conversion resolves), dbus_audit_coverage harness gate (dinit, parses audit summary in installer.log). Confirmed: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109. Also btrbk 0.32 config fix (snapshots now real), pages-race artifact staging live, turnstile stop-order.

Hardening family consolidated: hardening-config r2 = static sysctls 93-99 + family deps (apparmor/clamav/set-permissions); set-permissions r0 enabled at boot both inits; debug drop-in 99-feralos-debug; clamav enablement moved to the hardening-config packageLogic key (deps-installed packages need their rules keys on the family package). dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109 confirmed.

btrbk runs as ROOT via root's crontab; no btrbk user/group created (Alpine package creates none; dedicated user = SSH-remote scenario only). The removed run_as option was the only reason a btrbk user made sense — dropped upstream in btrbk 0.32.

Docs round: package-configs (hardening r2 family consolidation + set-permissions row + clamav-config r1 freshclam.conf), security_stack (clamav deps + enablement via hardening-config key), feature_confinement (hardening family note), storage (btrbk 0.32 syntax + the zero-snapshots story), harness artifacts (btrbk_config/btrbk_snapshot/config_packages_hardening/dbus_audit_coverage rows), variables.md (feralosRepoUrl override). Final proof: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109.

hardening.go fully replaced (92 lines: gate+cmdline+debug drop-in only). Everything else lives in hardening-config r3 (sysctls 93-99 static + family deps + clamav DB post-install pull) and set-permissions r0. Regression caught en route: apparmor packageLogic key dead after consolidation — moved to the family key + harness asserts. dinit 136/136 green.

packageLogic install couplings: any INSTALLED package whose rules key carries packages pulls them at runtime (clamav-daemon → freshclam, owner directive). Mechanism: packages.go applyInstallCouplings — loops to stability, applies ONLY the packages field against the live pkg list. Enablement of dep-installed services rides the FAMILY key (hardening-config), since the re-apply iterates HardeningPackages() only.

cmdline.d round complete: hardening cmdline fragment ships in hardening-config r4 (/etc/kernel/cmdline.d/50-hardening.conf + apk trigger reassembles+rebuilds UKI on upgrade), assemble-cmdline 0.1.0-r0 in a NEW repo skea999/assemble-cmdline (Go, /usr/sbin per FHS, full blocking gate). cmdline.d: 00-base (installer) < 50-hardening (package) < 99-debug (installer, enableDebug) — per-key last wins. 50-booster hook assembles live. Proof: dinit 136/136, apparmor=1 from the package fragment in the real kernel cmdline.

OpenRC 109/109 confirmed: all config-package stack (cmdline.d, hardening family, set-permissions, btrbk, vector) green on the fallback init too. The cmdline.d/hardening/pages-race round is fully closed on both inits.
